description: This file defines a utility function `mergeMockedModule` used for mocking modules in tests by merging an actual module with build overrides, supporting asynchronous overrides.

methods.name: export async function mergeMockedModule<TModule extends object>( mergeMockedModule
methods.description: An asynchronous function that merges an actual module object with overrides generated by the `buildOverrides` function, supporting partial updates and promises.
